import JudgeProblem

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  intro x y
  have p0 : x = (((x ◇ y) ◇ x) ◇ x) := h (x) ((x ◇ y)) (x)
  have p1 : y = ((x ◇ y) ◇ x) := h (y) (x) (x)
  have p2 : y = (((y ◇ y) ◇ y) ◇ y) := h (y) ((y ◇ y)) (y)
  have p3 : (y ◇ x) = (((x ◇ y) ◇ x) ◇ x) := congrArg (fun t => t ◇ x) p1
  have p4 : (y ◇ x) = ((((y ◇ y) ◇ y) ◇ y) ◇ x) := congrArg (fun t => t ◇ x) p2
  have p5 : (((x ◇ y) ◇ x) ◇ x) = (y ◇ x) := Eq.symm p3
  have p6 : x = (y ◇ x) := Eq.trans p0 p5
  have p7 : x = ((((y ◇ y) ◇ y) ◇ y) ◇ x) := Eq.trans p6 p4
  exact p7
